sources.description: The New York Giants selected Arvell Reese with the fifth overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft. Reese will now be paired with Abdul Carter, Brian Burns, and Kayvon Thibodeaux as versatile front-seven players for Dennard Wilson; however, Reese will be starting at linebacker next to the newly-signed Tremaine Edmunds.
